data.name: Mostak
data.gender_notes: Mostak is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mahesh', meaning 'Lord of the Gods'. It is a name of great power and strength, evoking the image of the Hindu deity Shiva, the destroyer and transformer. The name Mostak carries the meaning “Lord of the Gods” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Mostak usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the gods and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and strength of the divine, and the ability to destroy and transform the old to make way for the new.
data.etymology: Mostak belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Gods.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mostak total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
